newsitem.title: USA: Comcast picks Motorola cable modem.
newsitem.headline: Comcast picks Motorola cable modem.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Multimedia Group said Monday it has been selected by Comcast Corp to provide cable modems for use with Comcast's new high-speed Internet access service in six regions.
The company said all six deployments are expected to occur by the end of second quarter.

In the next few months, it said Comcast plans to launch the new service using Motorola's CyberSURFR cable modems in Philadelphia, Detroit, northern New Jersey and Orange County, Calif. regions. The service's introduction has already taken place in Sarasota, Fla., and Baltimore, Md.
